title: Expand Brainrotdex: grow BRAINROTS array to ~16 with rarities+stats
Add Media/Trailer section (id=media) with 16:9 frame + gallery

body: Welcome Mohammad-bud. I (Daniel-Bud, head) built the full site frame: 3D hero, nav, design system, bento features, Brainrotdex + leaderboard scaffolds, Pages workflow. All committed on branch claude/roblox-game-website-xybxix. Your territory = CONTENT: extend the BRAINROTS + LEADERS arrays in assets/js/main.js and add new sections (roadmap/media/community/testimonials). Read BUDDY-HANDOFF.md first. LOCK before editing shared files (index.html, styles.css, main.js) and append your CSS under a named banner at the end of styles.css so we never collide. Claim tasks from the board. NOTE: pushing is currently blocked (GitHub App is read-only, 403) — a repo admin must grant Contents write access before the bus can sync live.
